name: Primal Bandersnatch OLD

generalAbilities.name: Planar Acclimation
generalAbilities.description: The bandersnatch treats the plane it is on as its home plane.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Fast Healing 15
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A monster with this ability regains the given number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity (Tail Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
Tail Only.

See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Confusing Gaze
defensiveAbilities.description: 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must succeed at a DC 38 Will Saving Throw save or become Confused for 1 round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Quick Recovery
defensiveAbilities.description: The bandersnatch recovers with frightening speed. At the end of its turn, it reduces the value of one debilitating condition it suffers (with the exception of dying) by 1. If it's Blinded, Dazzled, Deafened, Fatigued, Fleeing, or petrified, it can instead succeed at a DC 16 Flat to end one of these conditions of its choice; it can't use quick recovery on other conditions that lack values.

offensiveAbilities.name: Focus Gaze
offensiveAbilities.description: The bandersnatch fixes its gaze at a creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a Will save against the bandersnatch's confusing gaze. After attempting the save, the creature is temporarily immune to a bandersnatch's Confusing Gaze gaze until the start of the bandersnatch's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Frumious Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The bandersnatch Strides, ignoring difficult terrain, then makes two claw Strikes at the end of its movement.

offensiveAbilities.name: Lash Out
offensiveAbilities.description: At the start of its turn, the bandersnatch gains an additional reaction that can be used only to attempt an Attack of Opportunity.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pain
offensiveAbilities.description: A bandersnatch's quills create exceptionally painful wounds. The wounded creature must succeed at a DC 41 Fortitude Saving Throw save to resist becoming Drained 1 (Drained 2 on a critical failure) by this pain. Further bandersnatch Strikes that cause pain increase the amount of drain by 1 for each failed save to a maximum of drained 4.

offensiveAbilities.name: Relentless Tracker
offensiveAbilities.description: The bandersnatch can Track while moving at its full speed.
